# Palm Bay Lots & Land | Vahid Rajabian

> Residential lots and land for sale in Palm Bay and Brevard County, Florida. Vahid Rajabian, Broker Associate with M. David Moallem, Inc. (License #BK3454072), has sold land in Palm Bay since 2003. Owner financing available on most residential lots, call for terms.

## About

Vahid Rajabian is a licensed Florida Real Estate Broker Associate with M. David Moallem, Inc. He has sold vacant land in Palm Bay and Brevard County since 2003. Inventory: about 2,200 lots total, about 580 active residential lots, starting at $41,000, plus commercial, industrial and multifamily land. He also helps clients sell land, buy or sell homes, and find a builder.

Owner financing: available on most residential lots, no bank required, no prepayment penalty. Full terms, including the APR, are on the price guide page. Call 321-333-7230 for terms.

## The Compound (Port Malabar Units 51, 52 and 53)

Lots in Units 51, 52 and 53 are sold only as one whole package. They are not sold one lot at a time.
